description: This file defines a platform-specific wrapper for the POSIX 'stat' structure, called 'musl_stat', to handle differences in structure layout across architectures (x64, ARM64, others) for modular builds. It declares functions for wrapping 'fstat' and 'stat' system calls with ABI adjustments.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_fstat
methods.description: Function to wrap the 'fstat' system call with ABI adjustments for musl.

methods.name: __abi_wrap_stat
methods.description: Function to wrap the 'stat' system call with ABI adjustments for musl.
